messages:
deploy-bot: Rolling staged rollout 10% -> v1.12.3 now (route: global). Release notes: https://go/release/1.12.3 :rocket:

lina_release: saw embed latency tail jump on the 10% cohort ~2m after shift, metrics graph here: https://grafana/r/abc123 :eyes:

tom_sre: confirmed, p95 spiked from 240ms -> 1.1s for a small subset. Error rate steady but tail latency up. digging into KV cache misses.

marco_infra: quick note — autoscale warmed but some shards showing KVCACHE OOM churn. might be quantized kernel pressure on the new variant.

sarah_pm: are we holding the rest of the rollout? what's the impact on users? customers-internal reported approx 0.5% increase in slow responses.

lina_release: request: STOP the ramp, pin traffic at 10% and open rollback window. @ops_lead can you call stop/go?

ops_lead: vote: stop. pining version and freezing rollout. @deploy-bot please pin v1.12.3 -> freeze traffic shift. :hand:

deploy-bot: Action: traffic.freeze applied. Canary traffic remains at 10%. Rollout paused by ops_lead at 1747536832. Link: https://go/deploy/locks/1747536832

marco_infra: suggested mitigation: revert kernel patch on canary hosts OR route canary to fallback model variant v1.12.2-quantless. Which do we want?

tom_sre: prefer routing to fallback variant in-region (safer). quick rollback command ready: `redeploy --to v1.12.2 --selector region=eu-west --max-in-flight=5`

lina_release: approved fallback plan. @deploy-bot prepare canary re-route playbook and notify on completion. also tagging release notes with known latency regression.

deploy-bot: Preparing route change. Will perform a 2-step sweep: (1) shift canary cohort -> v1.12.2-fallback, (2) monitor 10m, (3) if stable, unfreeze and re-evaluate. ETA for step 1: ~3m.

ops_lead: also creating incident ticket and scheduling 30m post-check meeting. Tagging: @oncall, @infra. Please attach traces.

lina_release: ack. thanks team, keep replies here. I'll update release notes and follow up with a short RCA if needed. :white_check_mark:
